data.name: Silent Dispatch
data.description: When the vigilante ambushes an enemy or enemies unaware of his presence, he can attempt a Stealth check at a -5 penalty. The result indicates the DC of Perception checks to hear the vigilante's attacks until an opponent's first action, when the DC returns to the normal -10 for hearing battle. Other enemies present can still see the attack; this talent only prevents the sounds of battle from alerting others.
